title: Formal proof map for external mathematical ingredients in Hilbert17
scope: Source-level mapping of substantial ingredients in the final proof chain, not a minimal declaration-level dependency graph. Read-only audit of Lean sources and existing receipts.

categories.P: Locally verified project proof or compatibility adapter
categories.M: Imported proved theorem from pinned Mathlib
categories.B: Locally verified backport of newer Mathlib support

verification.limitation: Same-kernel selected local replay uses the pinned imported library; no fresh replay of all transitive Mathlib declarations or independent-kernel verification is claimed.

conclusion: No bibliographic theorem survives merely as an unproved parameter or extra axiom of the final Hilbert17 conclusions. Intermediate real-closedness, Rolle, square-closedness, inverse-matrix and transfer hypotheses are discharged by formal proofs.
